$comment: Example hotkey layouts. Copy ONE "hotkeys" block into the "hotkeys" section of your settings.json (Settings → Advanced → About shows its location), or set keys in Settings → Hotkeys. Accelerators: Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win + A–Z, 0–9, F1–F24, Numpad0–9, Space, Insert, Delete, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Up/Down/Left/Right, Pause, ScrollLock, PrintScreen. A key without modifiers is only allowed for F-keys, Pause, ScrollLock and PrintScreen. null = unbound. saveClip saves everything in the buffer; its length is capture.bufferSeconds.
